plan.sheet_prompt:
One illustration of 4 separate small objects arranged in 2 rows of 2, evenly spaced across a single seamless background.
Theme: pieces that burst out of Batman Lego. Draw only the pieces listed, never Batman Lego itself and never a character, a person, a face, a hand, writing or a logo.
Style: glossy cartoon look, bold clean shapes, vivid colours.
Outline: none. Draw every piece directly on the background with no outline, border, stroke, die-cut edge or halo around it.
Each cell holds exactly ONE piece, isolated and centred in its own cell, a different piece or a different size and angle from every other cell:
Piece 1 (top row, left): bat signal
Piece 2 (top row, right): lego brick
Piece 3 (bottom row, left): cape piece
Piece 4 (bottom row, right): megaphone
Consistency: the same drawing style, lighting and colour quality for all 4 pieces.
Background: a single, seamless, solid pure #00FF00 green background covering the whole image in exactly one shade, with no tiled panels, no shading variations, no tint, gradient, vignette or glow, no shadows, no floor, no noise, and no objects other than the pieces.
Spacing: every piece has a generous empty margin on every side (at least 20% of its own size), nothing touches the edge of its cell, and no piece touches or crosses another.
plan.video_prompt:
Animate this illustration sheet as a 3-second clip. Every character performs its own big, highly expressive, cartoon-style animation in place, inside its own cell, showing a wide range of emotions:
1. bat signal, with big lively expressive movement in place
2. lego brick, with big lively expressive movement in place
3. cape piece, with big lively expressive movement in place
4. megaphone, with big lively expressive movement in place
Animation style: wide emotions, highly expressive faces and bodies, exaggerated squash and stretch, anticipation and follow-through, clear facial animation (eyes, eyebrows, mouth), secondary motion on ears, tails and props, each character on its own rhythm, lively and full of personality. Never a static pose and never only a gentle sway.
Keep every character inside its own slot of the 2x2 layout; nothing may touch or cross a slot edge, and characters never interact with one another.
Empty slots stay empty: do not add any character, object or effect to them.
Static camera, no zoom, no pan, no cuts. Keep the one flat pure green (#00FF00) background exactly as it is, the same shade everywhere: no shadows, no gradient, no noise, no glow.
Keep each character's design, proportions and colours unchanged and do not add outlines or borders.
